title: ACCA BT - Business and Technology
content_provenance: Domain names are the four parts of the ACCA BT (Business and Technology) syllabus study guide regrouped into the exam-weights used by this practice bank. Weights reflect the 50-question, 2-hour computer-based exam with a 50% pass mark. Topics are transcribed at summary level from the public syllabus; they are not an exhaustive objective list.

objectives.text: Types of business organisation and formal/informal structures
Span of control, centralisation/decentralisation, matrix and functional structures
Corporate governance definitions, board roles and committees
Agency theory and the separation of ownership and control
Stakeholder mapping and business missions and objectives

domains.name: Business Functions and the Wider Environment

objectives.text: PESTEL and Porter's five forces analysis
Human resource management, recruitment, selection and motivation
Marketing, the marketing mix and segmentation
Operations management, quality and production methods
Data vs information, TPS, MIS, DSS and executive information systems
Big data, cloud computing and data protection principles
Internal controls, authorisation, segregation of duties and least privilege
Cyber threats: phishing, ransomware and disaster recovery

domains.name: The Accountant in Business and Professional Ethics

objectives.text: Management vs financial accounting and accounting concepts
ACCA fundamental principles: integrity, objectivity, confidentiality, professional competence and behaviour
Ethical threats, safeguards, whistleblowing and anti-money-laundering
